newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Light showers seen over parts of S.Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Light showers seen over parts of S.Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast light showers in the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces for Thursday and said that elsewhere in the island would be dry.
It said in its daily weather report that fairly strong westernly winds will continue to blow along the western slopes of the central hills.
It reported no rainfall in hydrocatchment areas in the 24 hours ending Wednesday morning.
